answer: Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 61% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it. Since the tide index is rebuilt each epoch, the signal audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, as the relic embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
